justifications.CONVERSIONS(pairs): sandbox-only deg->ra: NOT a port gap — prod refuses these BY DESIGN and has a test pinning it (tests/test_angle_units.py::test_deg_to_rad_is_deliberately_absent, plus test_unit_conversions.py::test_every_conversion_targets_a_reachable_unit). Prod's invariant is that no conversion may target a unit no field can hold: every prod angle field declares deg and no prod field declares rad or VA, so deg->rad and kVA->VA could never fire there. A dead conversion is worse than a missing one because it reads as capability. The sandbox DOES make rad and VA reachable (its own fields and name suffixes declare them), so the pair is live there. Porting into prod was attempted on 2026-09-15 and correctly rejected by those two tests; it was reverted. Re-port only if a prod field that genuinely stores radians or VA is ever added.
